quote: There is no department of inquiry in which it is not full as easy to miss truth as to find it, even when the materials from which truth is to be drawn are actually present to our senses.
source: Harriet Martineau, How to Observe: Morals and Manners, Part I, Introduction, the opening sentence (Charles Knight, 1838)
